scope: One U-Boot RAM boot with maxcpus=1, then one CPU1 hotplug request after watchdog readiness

result.cpu: CPU1 present but offline at boot, then online=0-1 after one hotplug write; CPU1-pinned command and timer/scheduler activity observed
result.watchdog: Mainline nowayout WDT2 fed at 120-second timeout; pings advanced from 6 to 22 after hotplug
result.storage: eMMC stayed read-only and unmounted; factory p8 restored before RAM userspace
result.qt: Started once and remained PID 123; no display cycles or Qt restarts requested
result.recovery: Requested reboot returned stock Linux 3.4.113+ and Phoenix after 36.7 seconds; exact factory p8 and approved ADC postflight passed

limits: CPU1 was released after watchdog startup, so boot-time dual-core release is not yet validated.
U-Boot stops WDT2 and this image starts it at driver probe, leaving a pre-probe hang without proven automatic recovery.
CPU frequency, voltage, suspend and production power policy remain unqualified.
One run does not establish long-duration dual-core stability.
